 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Internacional coach Eduardo Baptista could make FOUR changes to the starting lineup for the clash with Coritiba.
 The Brasileirão Matchday 34 fixture is scheduled for Tuesday (3) at 9:30 p.m. (Brasília time) at Beira-Rio.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Mercado and Villagra could replace Maripán and Thiago Maia, respectively.
 There are two other question marks in midfield. Ronaldo and Bruno Henrique are competing for a spot.
 And Alan Patrick could miss out with thigh pain, with Vitinho the likely replacement.
 In that scenario, Inter's probable lineup is: Kauan Jesus; Bruno Gomes, Mercado and Juninho; Aguirre, Villagra, Ronaldo (Bruno Henrique) and Matheus Bahia; Bernabei, Vitinho and Alerrandro .
 Internacional are in 18th place with 35 points, while Mirassol, just above the relegation zone, have 37. Coxa, meanwhile, are 11th with 42.
